'''Tyler Patterson My COTVG''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Tyler Patterson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14612">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14612 My COTVG], DeckTech (Tyler "Darth Taint" Patterson, 15 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14612/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14612/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tyler Patterson]]
* '''Published:''' 15 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''My COTVG''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' I realy like this deck.
